subject: Admin events: on-demand samples, redaction, and export SLA
messages:
From: Audits Team <audits@northriver.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: 2028-06-21T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Request: operator/admin event samples + export proof of delivery

Hi Vanessa,

We're preparing our quarterly SOC 2 evidence package and need a short sample export of admin/operator events from Redwood for scope validation. Can you provide: 

- A 7-day sample (2028-06-01 to 2028-06-07) with full event fields (actor, action, object, timestamp (UTC), session_id, request_id, src_ip, region, role_change flag).
- Proof of custody: HMAC manifest (sha256) for each file and a signed delivery manifest.
- Redaction guidance: what PII fields are present and recommended redaction or tokenization approach.
- Delivery method: SFTP preferred; if not possible, provide secure Drive link with a one-time token and retention window.

We expect an initial sample within 48 hours to validate mapping, then a final bundle for attestation. Please include any constraints (retention windows, timezone normalization, and known gaps).

Thanks,
Peter Carroll
Audits Team
NorthRiver Health

Attachment: none

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: Audits Team <audits@northriver.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: 2028-06-21T10:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: operator/admin event samples + export proof of delivery

Hi Peter / NorthRiver audits team,

Thanks for the clear list — we can deliver the sample and the full export proofing you described. Quick items so we align:

- Export window: we can run an ad-hoc extract for 2028-06-01T00:00:00Z through 2028-06-07T23:59:59Z.
- Format options: newline-delimited JSON (recommended), Parquet (if you prefer analytic ingestion), or CSV.
- HMAC: we will provide a per-file HMAC-SHA256 manifest and a signed (PGP) delivery manifest.
- Redaction: by default we include src_ip and user_agent. PII fields we can redact or replace with reversible tokenization on request — list below.

Can you confirm: SFTP host (we can push) vs. a pull URL? Also confirm whether you need timezone-normalized timestamps (all UTC) and if session_id/request_id must be preserved verbatim.

I'll loop in Kimberly for the export manifest and Jordan for chain-of-custody packaging. Expect the initial sample (up to 5000 events) ready by end of day tomorrow once you confirm the delivery endpoint.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Customer Compliance 
Redwood Inference

Attachments: admin_activity_export_manifest_template.csv (stub), operator_event_field_catalog.md (stub)

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: 2028-06-21T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: operator/admin event samples + export proof of delivery

Vanessa / team — technical notes for NorthRiver: 

- Recommended sample format: NDJSON with one JSON object per line. Schema keys: timestamp_utc, actor_id, actor_type, action, target_type, target_id, request_id, session_id, src_ip, src_region, user_agent, outcome, role_before, role_after, metadata_tags. See attached field catalog.
- Redaction options:
  * Full redaction for src_ip/user_agent (masking last octet or tokenization)
  * Reversible tokenization on actor_id if required for cross-referencing (KMS-wrapped token store)
- Integrity: produce .ndjson.gz files and an accompanying manifest.csv with columns: filename, row_count, sha256, hmac_sha256, compressed_size_bytes. We'll sign the manifest with our PGP key.
- Retention & scope: our internal admin event stream retention is 18 months; however, on-demand extracts for audits can be produced for any within that window. Exports for >18 months require a special retrieval and incur additional prep time.
- SLA & throughput: small sample (<=5k events) — same day; full 7-day bundle (estimated 1.2 GB compressed) — 24 hours to assemble, 48 hours for signed delivery SLA.

Jordan: can you prepare the chain-of-custody template and confirm SFTP push workflow and IP allowlist requirements?

-Kim

Attachments: operator_event_field_catalog.md (detailed field mapping)

From: Peter Carroll <peter.carroll@northriver.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: Audits Team <audits@northriver.com>
Date: 2028-06-21T13:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: operator/admin event samples + export proof of delivery

Thanks — we prefer SFTP push to our inbound host. Details below: 

- SFTP: sftp.northriver.com, inbound path: /inbound/2028-06-21/
- IP allowlist: 54.227.12.44 and 35.182.91.10 (add both)
- We will provide our PGP public key for manifest signing and a host key for verification (attached).
- Timestamps: please deliver all timestamps normalized to UTC; keep session_id and request_id verbatim.
- Redaction: mask src_ip to /24 (last octet zeroed) for samples but include full src_ip in the signed production bundle unless we request otherwise.

Confirming an initial sample (<=5k events) by EOD tomorrow is acceptable. Appreciate the HMAC + signed manifest approach.

Best,
Peter

Attachments: northriver_sftp_pubkey.asc (PGP public key stub)

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com

1) Sample spec: 2028-06-01T00:00:00Z through 2028-06-07T23:59:59Z, NDJSON, mask src_ip last octet for the sample, include session_id/request_id verbatim, timestamps UTC.
2) Delivery: we will push to sftp.northriver.com:/inbound/2028-06-21/ from Redwood egress IPs 54.227.12.44 and 35.182.91.10.

4) Timeline: initial sample (<=5k events) — target 2028-06-22T17:00:00-07:00. Full attested bundle (if requested) — 48 hours after sample acceptance.
5) Chain-of-custody: Jordan will upload the signed custody PDF to the same SFTP location and provide a Drive link for long-term retention.

Attachments included in this thread: admin_activity_export_manifest_template.csv; operator_event_field_catalog.md; northriver_sftp_pubkey.asc
